description.en:
Set in the futuristic world, humans are facing a crisis like never before as immortal cultivators continue to invade their homes.
Teenager Wu Ran, notoriously known as a loser, almost loses his life while trying to save his goddess.
Through that near-death experience, he awakens a strange die system by chance.
But the catch is, every skill he acquires solely depends on luck.
Watch how an underdog finally turns his life around and rises to the top.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.en: Superpowers are everywhere, did I become the King of the Sea?

description.en: For unknown reasons, superpowers begin to run rampant, leading to frequent violent incidents. A boy named 'Xia Yi', who grew up in an island city, feels immense pressure. Fortunately, he also gains a powerful superpower, but this ability seems to have a bit of a "small problem"—it only has strange effects on the opposite sex. However, this does not apply to his childhood friend 'Hao Jie'...

title.en: It’s Neither Windy or Rainy, and nor Is It Clear

description.en: This is an era of concealing oneself. Who can see through the frivolous wholeheartedness or the stubbornness underneath the scar? Lin Zhi Leng, who is strong on the surface, has always believed in liking gentle and soft herbivore men. Until one day, a guy who has an evil smile appeared at her side… From there it began. A story only belonging to them began: Perhaps there is no sympathy in this world, but I am willing to accompany you and stay at your side forever.

Chen Xiao is an ordinary high school student, but his true identity is the protector of the "evil" and "hope". with the burden of guarding the secret of the night, he is the night god and is admired by all spirits. When this identity is inherited by a high school student who is afraid of trouble while he is being harassed by the "evil" and "hope" every day, what will he do?

After the humanity has run out of the energy resources, 12 new huge cities have been founded. All these cities have a system that is capable of evaluating its citizens' deeds. A high school student Wu Minglu, since he lies too much, is cast into the rank of the bad guys. As a result, the system tries to get rid of the irregularity and kill Wu Minglu, sending The Punishers of Karma to kill him. However, Wu Minglu is saved by an unknown person, who claims to know how to save him. Will Wu Minglu survive the ordeal?

altTitles.ja: 最弱ランクの最強鏢師

description.en:
The world came to an end, and cities became ruins. All living creatures had undergone unknown evolution and became monsters across the world! Mankind was forced to build base towns to survive, and escorts who possess various abilities to deal with monsters and beasts became an important existence in the new world connecting human settlements. A juvenile, Lu Renjia became an escort in an order to investigate the truth about the death of his elder brother. However, the journey of being an escort is dangerous, and the person behind the scene started to arouse more suspicion… “I'm the strongest Black Iron level escort! I'll beat anyone who dares to stand in my way!”

Seluruh dunia! Namun, perjalanan menjadi pengawal itu berbahaya, dan orang di belakang layar mulai menimbulkan kecurigaan yang lebih besar… “Aku pengawal tingkat Besi Hitam terkuat! To safely survive the 500-year waiting for the system to activate, Chu Xuan Yan decides to use this monkey, teaching it the terrifying powers of the Hell Whale and the self-determination magical arts, ensuring the monkey is fearless. Years later, this monkey becomes…

Nanxing Xuan, upon reaching adulthood, is tasked by his father, the king of Neptune to bring back a treasured spar that has been lost for 100 years. He now has to retrieve it from college student Nan Kaifeng, but first, he has to gain his trust.The problem is, that the only things he know about human interaction is from a book borrowed from his sister called "Indulgence, Beauty and, Seduction."  
  
Source:DiMuRie and Co
description.es: El neptuniano Xingxuan Nan fue enviado a la Tierra por su padre, con la misión de recuperar una piedra de cristal neptuniana que se perdió hace muchos años. Xingxuan Nan descubrió accidentalmente que el cristal estaba en manos de un estudiante universitario, Kaifeng Nan. Y para poder ganarse su confianza intentará formar una relación cercana con él, como su amante. Sin embargo, el único conocimiento que Xingxuan posee sobre el amor terrestre, se limita a un libro que tomó de una fujoshi de Neptuno, el “Manual de la indulgencia, belleza y seducción.”

He should have died, but when he opened his eyes, he discovered that he was no longer himself. I’m alive? What happened to my body? Could it be that I have turned into a mutated lifeform…

description.en:
Jiang Yan was forced into an arranged marriage by her stepmother, which quickly became a trending topic online. To get out of the mess, she agreed to a contract marriage with Gu Linxiu, someone she had just met.

What Jiang Yan thought about Gu Linxiu: wealthy, wheelchair-bound, and still mourning a lost love from his past.

Reality: he is rich — extremely so. His disability? Just a misunderstanding. And his "lost love"? She’s not dead at all. In fact, it’s her.

When Jiang Yan saw the wall full of photos of her and Gu Linxiu from their younger years — along with secretly taken pictures of her daily life — she was completely stunned.

Wait… was she in the dark about their relationship this whole time and no one told her?

description.en:
An unknown disciple from a small sect battling against the strongest in the cultivation world! The long journey working at cultivation, the realization of destiny and the chance to reach the apex of the world.  
  
Some are born great, some achieve greatness and some have greatness thrust upon them. Zuo Mo is a zombie faced low level cultivator in a minor sect of a little world. Ever since he was picked up by the sect leader two years ago, he has no memories of his earlier life except a recurring nightmare. Navigating the rigid class structure and intricacies of the cultivation world, as one of the lowest possible of the lowest class, Zuo Mo’s dream is to earn money, and lots of it through being a spiritual plant farmer. A chance occurrence reveals that someone powerful had changed Zuo Mo’s features and erased his mind. The money grubbing zombie decides to set out on a journey of cultivation to find out answers. Fate colludes with chance, the drums of war are beating, the ghost of his past is coming……

An unfinished love song, and a love that couldn't come true. One side is a childhood friend, another side is a classmate that's a silent protector. Facing reality's pressure and with destiny's teasing, promises become rejections; and they drift further apart. When the opportunity to meet comes once again, can they finish that unfinished love song?

Beside being shocked, his dormant scent gland — which was damaged and numbed for years — was stimulated under the double-dose of pheromones, reawakening his long-slumbering heat cycle…

description.en:
My cousin and I were engaged at the same time. She was engaged to the heir to the duke's house, and I was engaged to the second son.
But the eldest son died in battle, and the second son has now become the heir. To escape her reputation as a husband-killer, my cousin turned to my fiancé.
On the eve of our wedding, my fiancé decided to take her as his first wife and me as his concubine.
Everyone thought I would either swallow my pride or defiantly refuse this union. Instead, I declared, "I will marry the deceased young master instead."

[Submission for Yaoqi Village] [Submission for China Academy of Art]
Have you ever felt like this before? Like you're stuck, frozen in time, not sinking, but still exhausting yourself every day.
An old short story drawn in 2021. It's hard to recreate how I felt then. There's no words because I didn't know what and how to say it. Lacking self-control, I could only draw this to comfort myself the best that I could.
This is for our disjointed, disassociated, average lives. Dedicated to every ordinary person.

After an unexpected accident, the once cold and aloof young lord has transformed into a dainty, fragile ["Little Sister Lin"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lin_Daiyu), even using his good looks to win the affections of the other party!! However, as their relationship deepens, Jiang Jiao Jiao begins to uncover Ming Yu’s dark, obsessive tendencies and a massive family secret spanning two generations...
description.zh: 颜狗大危机！阳光土狗蒋骄骄(直男)对钟悯玉（男）的脸一见钟情! 一场意外，让原本高不可攀的冷面贵公子摇身一变成为撒娇易碎的“林妹妹”，还利用自己的美貌获得对方垂青！！ 可随着交往渐深，蒋骄骄逐渐发现钟悯玉的病娇本性，还有背后藏家族和两代人的巨大秘密…

description.en: The demons invaded and the humans were defeated. The male protagonist Ichiya and his childhood friend Taozi, became prisoners and were escorted to the devil’s lair, where humans were used by demons as laborers, experimental tools, and even food. With his witty mind, Yi Ye dealt with the four major demon masters and got the protection of the demon queen Monqier, but on the condition that he must fall in love with the demon queen and date her? ? ?
description.id: Setan menyerbu dan manusia dikalahkan. Protagonis laki-laki Ichiya dan teman masa kecilnya Taozi, menjadi tahanan dan dikawal ke sarang iblis, di mana manusia digunakan oleh iblis sebagai pekerja, alat eksperimen, dan bahkan makanan. description.en:
The noble son is soon to be split apart from his family. He, who is regarded as the prince's future wife, is secretly in love with the imperial guard Ye Mo… 
Ye Mo was born rebellious and is not afraid of challenging his fate, leading to an eventful and unbridled life! 
What is more important to them, their family's interests or the heart's desire? How do you choose between a carefree life and a life of great achievements? What will become of this 'secret love'?

She lost her original form and is now a loli, and as the latest reincarnation of her lover Ning Cai Chen, I'm obliged to restore her original form!?

The mighty cultivator transcended the boundaries of supernatural realms and, in order to fulfill their long-standing aspiration of ascension, decided to embark on a journey of reincarnation in a parallel world. With their innate talent for the Dao and the remnants of cultivation, this world has not been devoid of cultivators. It has merely been awaiting the reawakening of the era of cultivation!

Right before the corporate slave Lin Xiang’s debt was due, a chance to participate in a mysterious virtual game was presented to him.
By participating in the game, he not only paid off his debt but also seized the opportunity to launch a counterattack and turn his life around.
After he understood the system a bit better, Lin Xiang began to constantly wage wars in-game to expand his territory and strength.
While doing so, he discovered the cruel truth behind the game as well as the ultimate goal of the oligarchs, eventually revealing the rulers’ conspiracies.
description.fr:
Juste avant que la dette de l'esclave d'entreprise Lin Xiang ne soit exigible, une chance de participer à un mystérieux jeu virtuel lui a été présentée.
En participant au jeu, il a non seulement remboursé sa dette mais a également saisi l'opportunité de lancer une contre-attaque et de changer de vie.
Après avoir compris un peu mieux le système, Lin Xiang a commencé à mener constamment des guerres dans le jeu pour étendre son territoire et sa force.
Ce faisant, il a découvert la cruelle vérité derrière le jeu ainsi que le but ultime des oligarques, révélant finalement les complots des dirigeants.

description.en:
Ji Chi, the young master of a gang, was betrayed and murdered by his fiancé. He was then transmigrated 30 years in the past into the body of a 19-year-old. Here, the Alpha was saved by a kindhearted and gentle Beta during a time of desperation. However, the person who he thought was an angelic savior, had the exact same face as the murderer who killed him in his previous life...

The Head of the Laoshan Sect was attacked and killed by the Demon King.
When he was dying, his soul left his body and returned to the modern world after 300 years, His soul possessed the body of a weak man who eats soft rice. Now, he is determined to avenge himself against the Demon King, while also dealing with his mother-in-law......This new life isn't easy...

description.en: Mo Lang, a bad boy, and Bai Qi, his genius friend, lived a quiet life in a village in the distant country of Niuzhan. Until one day, a mysterious assassin from the country of Xuanwu appears, who completely subverts their lives, forcing the two youngsters to embark on an adventure that will change the world. The manhua is a prequel to the animated series Scissor Seven, chronicling events from before the original series.

The demon sword that destroyed the WuLin world has appeared once again, those who are possessed by it become "Blade Ghouls". Pei Lie is a simple bladesmith in LiuYing City, by chance he is dragged into this sinister plot that has been planned for years. Will he win in his fight against the dark forces?

How important is reincarnation? Do souls actually exist after death? How will meeting Shi Chenhua change Xia Ke's misfortune? An unspeakable and thrilling part-time job, exorcisms that embrace the soul, another fateful encounter…and a pair of hands hidden in the dark.  
  
A guarded young man with psychic abilities who lacks love asks an extremely lucky and bright college student: "Will you become my lucky charm?"

Do you believe in monsters? Are you eager to see ghosts? The legends from ancient times have been resurrected in the online world. The hackers in the robes have applied iron fists to the wizards. The collision between the mahogany sword and the network virus floods the entire

Gods and demons have descended upon the world, leading to the destruction of various nations one after another. With the last haven, Da Xia, on the verge of annihilation, they are on the cusp of their final victory, poised to rule the planet and enslave all of humanity. Countless warriors have fallen, and even Da Xia’s guardian god, Ying Che, can no longer hold on. But just as Ying Che perishes on the battlefield, he suddenly opens his eyes again and finds himself reborn ten years in the past—before any of it happened! Armed with memories and experience from his previous life, can Ying Che change everything, rewrite history, and prevent the disaster from striking once more?

However, with a turn of fate, his beloved suddenly loses memory and falls in love with him. He is overwhelmed with just as much joy as agony, as he waits with great anxiety for the arrival of this love.
description.ru: Планета Гера, 4443 год н. э. Прожив в браке семь лет, двадцатипятилетний Чэн Цзин понимает, что его супруг, молодой генерал Лу Тао, всё также холоден к нему, как и в первый день их знакомства. Именно поэтому Чэн Цзин решает обратиться в брачный офис, чтобы подать документы на развод. Однако, словно по велению судьбы, его возлюбленный теряет память и неожиданно влюбляется в него! Чэн Цзин счастлив, но вот вопрос... Как долго продлится это счастье, когда так хочется, чтобы эта любовь была непрерывной?

description.en: In this world, there exists certain types of men; they do not believe in working hard, or improving themselves. They are self-serving and care only for themselves. These men’s goal in life is to “eat soft rice” and they use any means possible to suck their tall, rich, and handsome lovers dry.Self-reliant System: Our goal is to rise up! Our goal is to persevere! We must “eat hard rice” and be self-sufficient! When numerous souls become bound by this system and enter into the bodies of those who only mooch off of their lovers, what will happen?
description.zh: 世界上有这样一种男人，他们不思进取，他们心肠恶毒，他们把吃软饭当做毕生目标，他们把高富帅对象坑得体无完肤。 系统：我们的目标是崛起！我们的目标是奋斗！我们要吃硬饭！！ 当无数个灵魂被系统绑定，进入一个吃软饭的人身体里，又会碰撞出怎样的火花？

description.en: A package from Hell, along with a mysterious stamp album, opens up a whole new world. Please sign for you package and embark mon a thrilling journey. Mailmen come and go while stamps last forever.

In the future world, technology runs the universe. An intelligent robot committed many mistakes as he did not fully trust human beings. As his punishment, he lost his job and was sent back into the ancient times. However, the device had accidentally brought him back to Ancient China, where he met a cold yet beautiful snake demon. A series of stories unfold as the two were brought together by fate…

Love is righteous! unrequited love is normal! The biggest fan of her figurative idol NaZha, silly LeiXingZi, one day suddenly travels to another world. She heard that the one she likes the most is also in this very same world! The love-smitten young girl wants to save NaZha from the dangers to come, yet NaZha has no idea what love is and is slowly but surely learning how to love from LeiXingZi. Will both of them be able to find happiness in the end?

There are thousands of evil spirits in the world, half of whom reside in the city of Shining Night. As for the remaining half, all of them died in the Northern Region of Canglang, which was held by the Heavenly Host, Xiao Fu Xuan. The only devil who had been imprisoned for 25 years is still alive. And, it is Wu Xing Xue, the Lord of Shining Night City.

But at the depths of despair, he stumbles upon a rare second Class Change… transforming into a Necromancer Sovereign, activating the Undead Calamity System, and gaining calamity-tier undead servants. Thus begins his path of the strong…

description.en:
A mysterious force descends upon Earth, giving rise to a horrifying civilization. 

While everyone is immersed in fear, struggling to survive, Qinnuo discovers that he can earn system rewards by manipulating the emotions of ghosts. 

With each completed instance, he can establish his own industry in this terrifying world. 

Whether as a waiter in the Yinquan Restaurant or a chief doctor in the Death Hospital... As Qin Nuo completes one instance after another, he realizes that he has become a giant in the ghostly realm.
A comedy about a puppy love affair that develops unexpectedly

Are you single? Are you an otaku? Would you like to buy a "wife"? Do you fantasize about eating, having fun, shopping, and sleeping with her? Can you promise to take responsibility and love her for a lifetime? Would you use your life to pay for a contract? A fantasy that belongs only to you; a maid that belongs only to you.

Using dangerous forbidden magic called "Fantasy Day", Last, the Blood Clan's leader, wants to help his daughter Lilo Ai realize her dream as a vampire. Even though she needs to depend on this magic her father is using, she can at least move about freely during the day, attend school and form friendships with Chong Yin and Fei Hu. Should her identity be discovered though, the magic will lose its power and her father's efforts will be for naught or worse. However recently, a number of girls have dropped out or transferred away from school because they said they were attacked by a "School Campus Vampire"…

title.en: The idiots at the high school of gifted males!

description.en: Edgar, Ace and I are roommates and go to a school surrounded by males who adore us. Help us! what should we do?

'HP' is commonly used in games to represent the life remaining in certain things, but have you ever wondered what it would be like to see the 'HP' of other things? Huang, able to see the 'HP' of everything in the earth, in his eyes, he sees that the 'HP' of the earth is about to reach zero. Facing this world which is on the verge of death, Huang, with the girl accompanying him, Miu, will they destroy or save the world?

It is a world of heroes, demons, villagers and kings. Oh, and dragons and magic, of course. Kings employ warriors – the Braves – and equip them with the resources they need to fight the demons and protect the villagers. The role of the villagers is to accept that protection, and the demons are there, naturally, to be destroyed. But does the world have to be like this? Or is it just the way it happens to be?

 

Must the Braves defeat the Demon King? Whose version of justice are they fighting for? Is the Demon King irredeemably evil? Was he born this way, or did something happen to him? What if both the Braves and the Demon King became who they are the same we ordinary folk do – by making the choices the world presents to us and accepting the consequences.

 

Yellow Book takes the tropes of a fantasy adventure and reimagines them, employing a humorous approach and a unique artistic style. This satirical work turns the usual image of the hero upside down. (BooksFromTaiwan)

“You won’t live past the age of 20…”  
  
“Since my illness is incurable…this must be my Fate then…”  
  
“But what if there is a secret to defy Fate? Are you willing to risk your life for one more chance?”  
  
With less than a decade of his life remaining and a marriage contract in his hands, Chen ChangSheng sets out from his secluded temple and heads toward the Capital to find the secret to defying Heaven and Fate.

altTitles.en: The Grand Master Came Down From the Mountain

description.en: Wudang Mountain, the sacred place of Taoism, is divided into internal and external. It inherits the highest classics of the Great Daoshu. Xie Luo, a modern Taoist, was trained in the heavenly book when he was young. In one fell swoop, he was the best in the northern Quan Zhen, the southern sect of Longhu Shan, the eastern sect, and the western sect of Shushan. The younger generation has been promoted as a contemporary Taoist walking in the world. Unexpectedly, the first task waiting for him is to hunt down the old Taoist walking in the world, who has been missing for many years…
description.id: Gunung Wudang, tempat suci Taoisme, memiliki berbagai macam perbedaan internal dan eksternal. Tempat Suci itu mewarisi hal tertinggi di dunia dan Daoshu Agung. Xie Luo, seorang pendeta Tao modern, dilatih di surga ketika dia masih muda. Dalam satu gerakan di Taoisme Wudang, Quanzhen, Maoshan, Longhushan, dan Shushan, lima sekte telah memenangkan gelar generasi muda, dan dipromosikan sebagai sekolah Tao kontemporer. Tanpa diduga, tugas pertama yang menunggunya adalah mencari Tao kuno yang telah hilang selama bertahun-tahun Berjalan di dunia...

One day, a frail-looking high school student named Ye Qiu accidentally accepts an invitation to test this app and gains the ability to hear people's inner thoughts and feelings. After his sister Ye Zi is assaulted and gravely wounded by a serial killer, Ye Qiu becomes determined to find out who the culprit is using his newfound power from "Mode II". description.es: "Modo II" es una aplicación que puede proporcionar a sus usuarios ciertas habilidades. Un día, un estudiante de secundaria de aspecto frágil llamado Shu Ye accidentalmente acepta una invitación para probar esta aplicación y adquiere la capacidad de escuchar los pensamientos y sentimientos internos de la gente. title.en: Xuan Yuan-Sword Legend: The Gate of Firmament

description.en:
In ancient times, the Heavenly Emperor opened the Gate of Firmament, connecting the Heavens and Earth. Even mortals could learn to ascend to the Gate to meet with the Emperor and to obtain divine powers in order to aid the mortal realm. Unscrupulous individuals took advantage of the Emperor's gesture, and plunged the human realm into chaos, filling the lives of the common folk with anxiety and weariness. At this time, the sibling gods Fuxi and Nüwa took pity on the people and convinced the Queen of Huaxu to close the Gate forcibly with the help of Emperor Zhuanxu. From then on, no one could reach the Heavens with impunity, and no god could travel to the mortal realm freely. This incident came to be known as the Isolation of the Heavens and Earth.   
  
Spin-off of the game 軒轅劍外傳穹之扉(The Gate of Firmament)

description.en:
After a divorce, Xia Xinghe became an old woman—without money, a house, or a beautiful face.But she suddenly changed everything. Xia Xinghe turned herself into a rich top hacker. 

“For everyone who laughed, bullied, or insulted me, you should line up to witness my legend!” But for her ex-husband who didn't have any relationship with her, you should stay back and not jump the queue.

description.en:
Lin Fang awakens an SSS-level artifact mastery talent, granting him the power to turn anything into a divine weapon. Armed with an invincible holy sword, clad in god-tier armor, and riding a flashy motorcycle, he reveals a shocking truth: all his equipment is formed from his contracted goddesses!

As terrifying beasts invade and the apocalypse descends, Lin Fang fights alongside his goddess companions. With love and power intertwined, he vows: “Wife, let’s ascend to the throne of the strongest—together!”
description.zh: 觉醒SSS级御物天赋，手持无敌圣剑，身穿神级铠甲，骑着拉风的摩托车，林放：我这身装备都是女神变的！异兽入侵，末世降临？老婆，随我一起杀上巅峰王座！

description.en: Because of an accident, Zhi Li lost her father who was her one and only family. Since then, Zhi Li often wakes up in the middle of her nightmare in which she is drowning. The suffocation close to death made her at loss. Even though Zhi Li is alone now, she’s trying hard to survive that even the nightmares and loneliness can’t stop her. On a raining morning, Zhi Li met a girl with a black umbrella, who walked into her lonely life and since then their fate got interwined.

Everything he had was reduced to ash! He was banished from his clan and subjected to the harshest of humiliations! But just as the phoenix is reborn from ash, his life will be born anew and his awakening shall shake the heavens and earth! All shall look up to him once he stands above the rest, and all shall know--- "He" is actually a "she"!

description.en: Transcending into the Great Tang, Shen Changqing thought he was living in a normal historical world, but little did he know that the maid working in his yard was a dragon princess, the stray dog he adopted was a Qingqiu fox immortal, the bricks he casually baked were supreme magical treasures, and all those customers who constantly pestered him for fortune-telling were top-notch tycoons. Originally, he only wanted to get rich using the knowledge of a transmigrator, but inexplicably, he was acclaimed as an all-powerful deity!
description.id: Shen Changqing, yang melakukan perjalanan ke Dinasti Tang, mengira dia hidup di dunia sejarah yang normal, tetapi dia tidak tahu bahwa pelayan yang melakukan pekerjaan serabutan di halaman rumahnya adalah seorang putri naga, anjing liar yang dia adopsi adalah Qingqiu Fox Peri, dan batu bata yang dia buat adalah senjata super ajaib. Dan pelanggan yang mengganggunya sepanjang hari untuk meramal dan meramal semuanya adalah bos top. Awalnya, dia hanya ingin mengandalkan cadangan pengetahuan para pelintas untuk menghasilkan banyak uang, tetapi entah bagaimana dia dipuji sebagai dewa yang mahakuasa!
description.zh: 穿越到大唐的沈长青，以为自己生活在一个正常的历史世界，却不知道，他院子里打杂的女仆是龙族公主，收养的流浪狗是青丘狐仙，随手烧制的砖头是极品法宝，而那些成天缠着他卜卦算命的顾客，全都是顶级大佬。 本来只想靠穿越者的知识储备发家致富，却莫名其妙被捧成了无所不能的大神仙！

description.en: A popular actress of the Xing Yao Future entertainment industry returns to the campus as a teacher for a youth campus film. However, honing acting skills and experiencing life is only a cover. Her real purpose is to trace the truth six years ago. She abandoned "Xia Xing Chen" identity and is now known as "Xia Wei Lai". Nowadays, the Adonis, Li Xing Bai, and gentle music teacher, Chen Chu Luo, and Xia Wei Lai, the three people's feelings are gradually becoming intertwined. The truth of that year is hidden in the midst of feelings, how will Xia Wei Lai choose?

On the planet Eruthyll planet, humans obtained unique crystal veins called Dubriostal, based on which they developed brilliant magic tech.

Feeling blessed by Dubriostal, people start to worship and deify Dubriostal, thus resulting in the emergence of Crystalis Conflux. Steeped in Crystalis Conflux's propaganda, people discriminate against those who cannot resonate with the Dubriostal, branding them as Castaway and claiming their souls are incomplete. Crystalis Conflux secretly devised an evil plan; only Castaways can see through their lies. To fight against the Crystalis Conflux and save the world, Castaways formed their resistance group - Gopher Troupe.

This manhua elaborates on the founding of Gopher Troupe and Castaways' glorious path of struggle.

In her first life, she loved him but he left her for another. She died and was reborn, but even so she still loved him and he made her lose everything. Second rebirth, all she wants is to stay away from him…

description.en: A young girl named Ji Yue, finds herself drawn into the world of "Alice in Wonderland," a fairytale book left behind by her missing brother. Alongside Long Ya, an apprentice librarian at the Ark Library, they discover that the once idyllic fairytale paradise described in the book has transformed into a twisted haven of sin. Pursuing clues related to this darkened paradise left by her brother, Ji Yue and her companions set off on a quest to find her brother and unravel the true nature of this distorted wonderland.
